To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) metabolic networks are small-world networks; (2) metabolic networks are scale-free networks; (3) metabolic networks are hierarchical networks; (4) metabolic networks are modularity networks; (5) metabolic networks are robust networks.

the scale-free property of metabolic networks is due to the preferential attachment mechanism, which is a consequence of the evolutionary pressure for metabolic networks to maintain robustness against random gene deletion and that the scale-free metabolic networks have a small-world effect, which results from the hierarchical modular structure.

metabolic network is an extremely complex and heterogeneous system, and the heterogeneity and the complex structure of metabolic networks are the major factors for the robustness and evolvability of metabolism.
